issues.detail: The Hebrew names פֶּלֶת (Peleth) and זָזָא (Zaza) are personal names, not gentilic/ethnic designations. The Chinese renders them as '培肋設人' (Pelethites) and '撒薩人' (Zazaites), adding the suffix '人' (people), which changes the meaning from individual sons to groups of people. This is a mistranslation of proper names.
